name: Moonbeam Croissants
description: Flaky golden croissants sprinkled with moonflower sugar.
magicalDetail: Eating one brings especially peaceful dreams.

name: Dreamer's Cinnamon Rolls
description: Soft, freshly baked cinnamon rolls with a delicate swirl of cinnamon.
magicalDetail: Eating one brings back the memory of your happiest moment.

name: Lavender Cloud Buns
description: Soft, fluffy buns with a delicate lavender sweetness.
magicalDetail: Eating one makes you feel wonderfully lighthearted.

name: Golden Hour Cookies
description: Golden, buttery cookies with a delicate honey glaze.
magicalDetail: Eating one fills you with the warmth and happiness of a perfect summer afternoon.

name: Blackberry Star Tarts
description: Delicate star-shaped tarts filled with dark blackberry jam.
magicalDetail: Eating one reveals tiny, shimmering constellations that dance in the air around you.

name: Whispering Plum Pies
description: Rich little plum pies with golden, flaky pastry.
magicalDetail: Eating one brings a comforting whisper of encouragement when you need it most.

name: Wishing-Star Éclairs
description: Elegant éclairs filled with silky vanilla cream and topped with shimmering sugar.
magicalDetail: Making a wish while eating one gives it a little extra chance of coming true.

name: Stardust Macarons
description: Delicate macarons that shimmer under moonlight.
magicalDetail: They leave a faint sparkling trail.

name: Hearthglow Scones
description: Warm, buttery scones with a hint of honey and vanilla.
magicalDetail: They stay pleasantly warm for hours after baking.

name: Moonflower Shortbread
description: Buttery flower-shaped shortbread with a delicate dusting of vanilla sugar.
magicalDetail: The little sugar flowers shimmer softly when the moon is out.

name: Rubyberry Danishes
description: Flaky golden pastries filled with sweet ruby-red berry compote.
magicalDetail: Their berry filling glimmers like tiny jewels in the light.

name: Little Star Biscuits
description: Tiny, buttery star-shaped biscuits dusted with golden sugar.
magicalDetail: They give off a faint twinkle when placed beneath the stars.

name: Moonlit Lemon Tarts
description: Bright little lemon tarts with a silky filling and delicate pastry shells.
magicalDetail: Their lemon filling catches the light with a soft, silvery glow.

name: Fairy-Knot Twists
description: Delicate twisted pastries glazed with honey and a touch of cinnamon.
magicalDetail: Their little knots always seem to rearrange themselves into different patterns overnight.
